about: Tokens one real beginner bought on Solana from January 2023 to May 2026 (mostly 2023), with what became of each and what token_safety says about it. No wallet, dates, amounts or prices: only the token, its outcome and the checks. outcome: lost_most = price now at most 10% of what was paid; kept_value = above that; no_market_today = Jupiter prices it no longer; unknown = no purchase price on record (bought with another token, or received).
checked_with: token_safety 0.6.0 (live, Jupiter API key, not-tradable rule)
